suite.name: Bandwidth

kw.name: Open Bench
kw.doc: Load the bench, its calibration and the radio file, and prepare the instruments. All four are mandatory and differ from tester to tester, so suites take them from the command line (-v BENCH:... and so on). `firmware` names what the radio runs, such as a git describe.

test.name: FM RX At 12.5 kHz Rejects An Adjacent Channel

kw.name: Operator Does
kw.arg: Set the bandwidth to 12.5 kHz, volume comfortable
kw.doc: Ask the operator to do something and wait until it's done.

kw.name: Start Transmitting With Interferer
kw.msg: Transmitter gain capped: the wanted signal is 3.8 dB below a plain tone
kw.doc: Loop the wanted FM tone on the test frequency plus an interferer, interferer_db stronger, interferer_offset_hz away, modulated with a different tone so the operator can tell which one they hear.

kw.name: Operator Confirms
kw.arg: The wanted signal alone: a clean, steady 1 kHz tone
kw.doc: Ask the operator a yes/no question; fail the test on no.

kw.name: Stop Transmitting
kw.doc: Stop the transmitter.

kw.name: Start Transmitting With Interferer
kw.msg: Transmitter gain capped: the wanted signal is 3.8 dB below a plain tone
kw.doc: Loop the wanted FM tone on the test frequency plus an interferer, interferer_db stronger, interferer_offset_hz away, modulated with a different tone so the operator can tell which one they hear.

kw.name: Operator Confirms
kw.msg: Operator: You hear only the steady 1 kHz tone: no 400 Hz tone and no noise from the channel above -> no (dont hear the tone but do hear some slight white noise)
kw.arg: You hear only the steady 1 kHz tone: no 400 Hz tone and no noise from the channel above
kw.doc: Ask the operator a yes/no question; fail the test on no.
kw.status: Operator: You hear only the steady 1 kHz tone: no 400 Hz tone and no noise from the channel above -> no (dont hear the tone but do hear some slight white noise)

kw.name: Stop Transmitting

kw.name: Start Transmitting With Interferer
kw.doc: Loop the wanted FM tone on the test frequency plus an interferer, interferer_db stronger, interferer_offset_hz away, modulated with a different tone so the operator can tell which one they hear.

kw.name: Operator Confirms
kw.arg: With the interferer on the channel below: still only the 1 kHz tone
kw.doc: Ask the operator a yes/no question; fail the test on no.

kw.name: Stop Transmitting
kw.doc: Stop the transmitter.

test.status: Operator: You hear only the steady 1 kHz tone: no 400 Hz tone and no noise from the channel above -> no (dont hear the tone but do hear some slight white noise)

suite.doc:
FM follows the 12.5/25 kHz channel bandwidth setting, on transmit and on receive.
Transmit is measured from the SDR capture. Receive is judged by the operator, until the radio can report its own audio. The programming cable stays out throughout: it disconnects the mic and the speaker.
To measure stock firmware as a reference, run with --exclude m17 and compare the two exports with oat compare.
